description:
The BMX World got thrown off it's axis when Clint Miller debut the original Torker 26" in 1980... Then the world was rocked again with the 2024 tribute.
NOW, for 2025, the godfather of all BMX cruisers, The Torker Barbarian GEN II Frame Set is back.
New Retro Race Geometry:
Pro 26" -
Chrome Plated
Traditional dual top tube race frame
Double Thick ( 1/4" ) Laser Cut Cro-mo Dropouts
Modern Chainstay Brace
Modern Machined Headtube Rings
3/8" dropouts front and rear
21.1 quill stem (Ultra 6 21.1 Quill Stem)
Retro Frame Cable Clips

components.description: 1” ( 21.1 ID ) retro, 4130 Cro-mo Heat Treated Torker threaded forks
1" threaded MX2 Style BMX headset - (26.4mm Bottom Race, 32.7mm ID Headtube)
